files.Title: MakesCentsBackend.Models.SetEnvelopeFundingQueueRequest
files.Summary: Request model to set (create/reorder/update/remove all at once) the funding queue for a budget month. The list's order is the funding priority - item 0 is funded first.

files.Title: MakesCentsBackend.Models.SinkingFundEnvelopeEntityModel
files.Summary: Model for a sinking fund envelope. Sinking fund envelopes are persistent - one row holds a live remaining_amount that carries forward month to month, unlike rollover envelopes.

files.Title: MakesCentsBackend.Models.SummaryBudgetResponse
files.Summary: Response model for a single budget in a user's budget list - just enough to let them pick which one to open, before any month/id is known.

files.Title: MakesCentsBackend.Models.SummaryBudgetTemplateResponse

files.Title: MakesCentsBackend.Models.SummaryEnvelopeCategoryResponse
files.Summary: Response model for an envelope category for the Get Budget method

files.Title: MakesCentsBackend.Models.SummaryEnvelopeResponse
files.Summary: Response model for a single envelope for the Get Budget method. Sinking fund and rollover envelopes come from two different tables with two different id spaces, so IsSinkingFund tells the frontend which table EnvelopeId belongs to (same pattern SummaryAccountDTOModel uses to distinguish bank/debt/investment accounts). RemainingAmount is nullable because a rollover envelope may not be activated for the month being viewed.

files.Title: MakesCentsBackend.Models.TransactionEffectSnapshotModel
files.Summary: Internal helper: what a transaction currently does to account balances, plus whether it is soft-deleted. Used by the delete/restore methods to reverse or re-apply its effect.

files.Title: MakesCentsBackend.Models.TransactionEntityModel
files.Summary: Model for an abstract transaction

files.Title: MakesCentsBackend.Models.TransactionSplitEntityModel
files.Summary: Model for a transaction split model. EnvelopeId is a display/API-level id - IsSinkingFund says whether it refers to a sinking_fund_envelope_id or the persistent rollover_envelope_id (not the month-specific rollover_envelope_month_id, which is an internal DAO detail).

files.Title: MakesCentsBackend.Models.TransactionSplitSnapshotModel
files.Summary: Internal helper: the raw current state of one transaction_split row, used to reverse its old effect on an envelope's remaining amount before an update applies the new one.

files.Title: MakesCentsBackend.Models.TransactionSplitTransferSideModel
files.Summary: Internal helper for reading one side of an envelope-to-envelope transfer back out of transaction_split (used by TransferTransactionDAO/TransactionDAO, not exposed to the API).

files.Title: MakesCentsBackend.Models.TransferTransactionEntityModel
files.Summary: Model for a transfer transaction. v3's transfer_transaction table only carries account columns - an envelope-to-envelope transfer is a transfer_transaction row of type Envelope with null account columns, paired with two opposite-signed transaction_split rows that carry the actual envelope references.

files.Title: MakesCentsBackend.Models.TransferTransactionSnapshotModel
files.Summary: Internal helper: the current type/accounts/total_amount/budget_month_id for a transfer transaction, read before an update is applied so the old effect (account balances or envelope remaining amounts, depending on type) can be reversed and the new one applied.

files.Title: MakesCentsBackend.Services.DataAccessLayer.EnvelopeFundingDAO
files.Summary: Data access object for the envelope funding queue - a budget month's plan for how much to put into each envelope and in what priority order. This is a plan only; it doesn't move money on its own the way a transaction does.

files.Title: MakesCentsBackend.Services.DataAccessLayer.PaycheckDAO
files.Summary: Data access object for paychecks. Paychecks are forecast-only now - they don't fund envelopes directly (see EnvelopeFundingDAO for that) and aren't tied to any specific month, so this is plain single-table CRUD.

files.Title: MakesCentsBackend.Services.DataAccessLayer.RolloverEnvelopeDAO
files.Summary:
Data access object for rollover envelopes. Rollover envelopes are split across two tables:

  • rollover_envelope: the persistent definition (name, category, default transfer target). No dollar amounts live here since a rollover envelope isn't guaranteed to be active every month.
  • rollover_envelope_month: the amounts for one specific month. Absence of a row here means the envelope wasn't activated that month. Most "get/update amount" operations need a budget_month_id in addition to the envelope id.

files.Title: MakesCentsBackend.Services.DataAccessLayer.SinkingFundEnvelopeDAO
files.Summary: Data access object for sinking fund envelopes. Sinking fund envelopes are persistent - one row per envelope, with a live remaining_amount that carries forward month to month (no monthly instance table, unlike rollover envelopes).
